news.title: Butler University Breaks Ground on Whitehill Ballroom, Advancing Midtown Arts District Vision
news.summary_en: New 1,400-capacity venue marks the next major milestone in Butler’s long-term investment in arts, culture, and community connection, and honors the legacy of Allen Whitehill Clowes Butler University officially broke ground today on the Allen Whitehill Clowes Ballroom (Whitehill Ballroom), marking the next major phase in the University’s broader vision for a vibrant Midtown Arts…
news.author: Mark Apple
